purpose: C0 run contract: the exact commands, environments, ownership and allowed paths the uninterrupted window executes.

applicationSuite.why: It is the only path that carries the guarded authority: marker acquisition, database lease, per-child deadline, abandonment handling, and the verdict/exit-code contract, with the launch gate re-evaluated after every await (R6-01). Direct Vitest execution bypasses all of it. The runner releases the LEASE; it contains no cluster-stop operation and never claims to stop PostgreSQL — cluster startup/shutdown belong to the surrounding operator window (R6-07).
applicationSuite.note: Each line is a separate gated command. Stop on nonzero status; do not continue through failure.

nativeUnit.note: test:node is an explicit file list; new native files are NOT auto-discovered and must be wired exactly once in backend/package.json row 19.

browser.note: The launcher rejects an absent or unowned BASE_URL rather than selecting a fallback server.

typecheck.retainedCaveat: The heap setting declares an intent, not available memory. Record actual completion or the exact blocker.

run-owned-postgres-matrix.why: It is the historical matrix runner. Its recorded 10-suite/125-test result does not execute the new application suites, and it does not carry the marker/lease/verdict contract that C1 makes load-bearing.

config/config.cjs.why: Line 1 is require('dotenv').config({ path: '../.env' }). A harness resolved through it inherits the application environment, so it cannot establish an independent test identity and its --env development invocation pointed at the application database.
config/config.cjs.boundary: This is a retirement for test/migration execution only. The application's own runtime config is untouched.

vitest.coach-completion.config.mjs.why: 04-build-order row 7 proposed a separate completion config. Row 14 of the forged order keeps the existing backend/vitest.coach-postgres.config.mjs and states 'no alternate completion config'. The existing guarded config is the single config (R5-06).

migrationConfig.status: TO BE CREATED in C2 (build-order row 20). Required now as an ALLOWED PATH, not required now as a file.
requirements: No dotenv import of any kind — R4-04 and R5-06 both bind this.
Missing port is a failure, not a default.
Invalid port is a failure, not a coercion.
Fixed loopback identity for the admitted synthetic cluster only.
migrationConfig.note: A future implementation deliverable. Its absence does not block C0 admission (R5-07).

environment.reason: No owned PostgreSQL cluster was provisioned during C0 preservation work, so connection identity could not be observed. G0-DB remains present-but-insufficient until an owned-cluster provisioning/teardown receipt and the actual connection identity exist.
environment.historicalPortNote: Port 55440 appears in historical records. It is NOT current ownership and must not be reused on that basis.

workspaceOwnership.note: The dirty-source manifest, not base HEAD, identifies the reviewed candidate.

preservationRules.lineEndings: core.autocrlf=true in this repository. TWO layers, kept separate (R6-08): (1) BASELINE — committed blobs via git cat-file blob, which are LF; (2) CANDIDATE — raw current bytes from disk as read, never normalized, never smudged; the candidate manifest hashes RAW FILES and says so. A check that mixes the layers reports phantom mismatches.
preservationRules.neverEditIntoCorrectness: Preserved documents are superseded, not corrected in place.

allowedPaths.note: Exact path assignments (R6-06): identical to the v9 controller C0 slice scope. laterSlices unchanged from v1.

scopeRule: Environment preparation commands and any new browser backend fixture/launcher files must be allocated exactly in C0 before admission. No unnamed runtime harness is implicitly authorized by the build-order table. A failing test does not widen production service scope - record behavioral RED, allocate exact paths and interfaces, then apply a bounded amendment.
